system.description:
GRIMWARD UTILITY WARDING
Grimward Specialist Spell
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet
Targets One magic item, haunt, ward, magical trap or persistent magical effect

You surround a dangerous magical working with a temporary containment lattice.
Make a Counteract check against the target.
Critical: The magical properties of the target are suppressed for 10 minutes.
Success: They are suppressed for 1 minute.
Failure: The effect remains active.
Fumble: The effect remains active and cannot be targeted by Quarantine Working again until the beginning of your next turn.
Suppression does not destroy, identify or permanently disable the target. Mundane functions continue normally.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Increase the range to 60 feet.
+4 PP: On a Critical, suppress the effect for 1 hour.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. Against a haunt or magical trap (target its token): the core rolls the Counteract and suppresses it — Critical 10 minutes (1 hour with the +4 PP warp), Success 1 minute; a Fumble or Blunder triggers it. Against an item, ward or effect, resolve the check from the note.
